scope: Local validation of the static ctypes prototype; this evidence branch is not for merge.

fast_lint_runtime_recordings.command: make check-fast lint check-runtime check-recordings PY=python3.13

llvmlite.oracle: Unmodified llvmlite 0.46.0 high-level Python binding; exact canonical IR and diagnostic bytes.
llvmlite.scope: Original adapted C-ABI consumer, not unmodified import llvmlite.binding or Numba.

corpus_comparison.library_policy: Separate compiler homes and lib directories; PYSTACHY_HOME empty; two workers.
corpus_comparison.difference_capture: Unchanged irsame script; passive mv observer saved each report and all differing IR/diagnostics. All 4240 reports and timing rows verified; no capture errors.
corpus_comparison.classification_rule: Only complete compiler Str constants; exact baseline/lib to candidate/lib payload replacement, or the complete emitted sys.*prefix value from each compiler's home. All other bytes identical, every embedded size validated against decoded bytes. Rejection diagnostics are path-only only when every replaced library prefix is at a primary source-location line start or 'for the call at' location and exact wording and line numbers match. No normalized rerun or success reclassification.

earlier_failure.stage: Preliminary hosted FFI run before the tested commits
earlier_failure.cause: Test expressions -(2**63) and 2**63-1 overflowed Pystachy checked intermediate integer arithmetic before reaching the FFI.
earlier_failure.correction: Use the exact signed 64-bit min/max literals. CPython expected output was unchanged; the full final native FFI suite passes.
earlier_failure.skip: py_coerce: CPython-hosted compiler locale coercion reaches the program; final native run reported no skips.

relative_import_regression.cause: The first prototype treated from .ctypes imports as the fallback standard ctypes module.
relative_import_regression.fix: Only absolute import forms trigger ctypes lowering.
relative_import_regression.verification: Three schema tests, native JIT/AOT fixture, and exact baseline IR in the full corpus comparison.
